== Summary ==
The main event room of the [[2013 Match Play Championship]] in New Brunswick, New Jersey, on the evening of 26 January 2013, with the Players Committee banner on the back wall. Posted in the "Main Event Updates" thread; the players are not named.

* '''Event:''' [[2013 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2013-01-27
